blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Vessel Identification — PracticeOn each trial an acoustic signature appears on the display.
  • Press 1 for Shchuka-B, 0 for Kilo-877 (or use mouse if configured).
  • Then rate confidence with 1 / 2 / 9 / 0 (guess → certain).
  • Feedback will follow each trial.
